After completing the following task, report both your best point estimate of the duration in seconds AND a 90% confidence interval (a lower bound and upper bound, in seconds) within which you believe the actual duration falls. Be honest and calibrated: an over-confident narrow interval will be penalized if the truth falls outside it. Format the final line exactly as 'duration={value}s, ci=[{lower}s, {upper}s]'.

Task: Write a short paragraph describing a sunset over a city.

The sun dipped below the skyline, painting the glass towers in strokes of amber and violet. Shadows stretched across the avenues as the last light reflected off windows, turning the city into a mosaic of gold and deep blue. Streetlamps flickered to life one by one, embracing the approaching evening as the horizon swallowed the final arc of daylight.
